notes: ACCESS: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (explicitly allows Claude-User); direct requests without impersonation get 403 (WAF), curl_cffi impersonate='chrome131' fetched every page cleanly (HTTP 200) - Tier 1 (HTTP fetch) sufficient, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. DISCOVERY: checked homepage full mega-menu (all 7 departments: kitchen-accessories, cookware-and-bakeware, drinkware, electricals, knives-scissors, special-offers, tableware-dining, plus new-in), sitemap.xml (13523 lines, all shop/* URLs), and robots.txt. Site has NO unified 'Bestsellers' department or hub page (confirmed absent from sitemap's 7 top-level /shop/ departments) - genuine bestseller listings are instead scattered as individual sub-category pages inside two departments: cookware-and-bakeware (2 pages) and knives-scissors (1 page). Case-insensitive search for 'best' across the entire rendered homepage HTML (5259 lines, all department dropdowns fully SSR'd) turned up exactly these 3 genuine matches plus irrelevant boilerplate ('best possible experience' text) - no other department (drinkware, electricals, tableware-dining, kitchen-accessories, special-offers) exposes a best-selling page. Site search is an Algolia-backed Livewire widget (AJAX, no URL-addressable results page), so nav+sitemap were used as primary discovery per project convention for JS-widget search. VERIFICATION: each candidate opened and confirmed via its Livewire wire:snapshot JSON embedded in the page - categoryIdent, department/group context, h1 heading, and page copy all independently confirm each is the site's own genuine 'best selling' merchandising concept (not a badge-only PDP, not editorial). No unifying parent page links the three together, so no grouping row is emitted - each is a standalone genuine site-defined listing per brief section 3 ('If only a single Bestsellers listing exists, output just that one row'; here there are three independent ones instead of one). SCOPE NOTE: unlike the prior Home-Decor pass for this company (SR274/archive c319), which deliberately narrowed extraction to Tableware & Dining + Glassware/Drinkware (a room/category-scope convention), this Bestsellers pass is a site-wide merchandising-PLP extraction per this project's brief and is NOT scoped to that narrower category - cookware/bakeware/knife-set bestseller listings are in-scope here even though cookware itself was out of scope for the Home-Decor category project. SIBLING CHECK: this project separately extracted ProCook India in an earlier batch; this UK site was investigated independently on its own merits rather than assuming parity, and in fact its bestseller structure (3 scattered department-level pages, no hub) may differ from India's - not verified against the India file, per instructions to only check independently, not merge/compare records.
